caveats: Continued from v3.1; this is not a fresh base-model comparison.
Training completes exactly one epoch; evaluation uses the best validation checkpoint within that epoch, excluding untrained baseline.
Original v3.1 test inputs, categories, labels, modes and supervision are preserved; no gold remapping.
All v3.1 test inputs are unchanged; code functions remain complete.
New taxonomy weak annotations are excluded from validation gold and native benchmark gold.
Validation scores use v3.2 observed label slots and differ from historical aggregates.
Native test rows are counted by task and case ID; repeated source groups are not necessarily independent examples.
Code vulnerability tests can be highly imbalanced; consider balanced accuracy and unsafe recall alongside raw accuracy.
Routing path scores start at the root, without gold intermediate nodes; probability gates are uncalibrated.
Latency is one-case-per-GPU forward time with other GPU workloads potentially sharing hardware.
